length = int(input())
str_input = input()

import re

pattern = r"\([a-zA-Z_]*\)"
replaced_str = re.sub(pattern, "_", str_input)

split_parts = re.split(r"_+", replaced_str)
max_part_length = max((len(part) for part in split_parts), default=0)
print(max_part_length)

total_count = 0
inside = False
start_idx = -1
end_idx = -1
for i, c in enumerate(str_input):
    if c == '(':
        inside = True
        start_idx = i
    elif c == ')' and inside:
        inside = False
        end_idx = i
        inside_str = str_input[start_idx + 1:end_idx]
        if inside_str:
            parts_inside = re.split(r"_+", inside_str)
            total_count += len(parts_inside) - (1 if inside_str.startswith("_") else 0)
print(total_count)
